overall_notes: This paper focuses on Chinese script conversion (Simplified to Traditional Chinese) rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The main NLG aspect is the script conversion task itself. The paper includes both automatic metrics (DED, SA) and human evaluation with annotators validating conversion quality. While the paper mentions various models and datasets, the core NLG evaluation is focused on the script conversion outputs.
